summary: __thiscall helper that dereferences a linked-list node via LinkedListDereference(this); if the node is non-null it invokes RaceStandingsRankingsComputation(node) and returns the low byte of that call's result. When the dereference yields null it returns 0. The second parameter a2 is unused by the body.

operations.description: Call LinkedListDereference(this) and store the node pointer result in v2.
Guard: proceed only when the dereferenced node v2 is non-zero.
Call RaceStandingsRankingsComputation(v2) and store the result (truncated to a byte) in v2.
Return v2, which is either 0 (null node) or the low byte of the computation result.

unresolved: Purpose of the unused second parameter a2 is unknown.
Semantics of RaceStandingsRankingsComputation's byte-truncated result and why only the low byte is kept are unknown.
What a non-null node plus a computation result means for season-data freeing is not established by this packet.
